payload.reason: The evidence provides specific modifications made to post-trained BERT, including the application of adversarial training and adjustments in training epochs and dropout values to enhance performance in Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA).

claims.text: Adversarial training is applied to post-trained BERT (BERT-PT) to improve its performance in Aspect Extraction and Aspect Sentiment Classification tasks.
The model's performance is enhanced by optimizing the number of training epochs and dropout values during training.
The proposed model, BERT Adversarial Training (BAT), outperforms post-trained BERT in both tasks of ABSA.
